what: Empirical 90th percentile of |miss / (slow spread x sqrt(q) x multiplier)| per group, in band units. Use as the band edge instead of 1.645. Walk-forward verified in band_calibrate.py.
fit_years: all years 2006 on in the matrices
caveats: An explanation band: it is scored with the same day's market-wide stress.
Fitted on all years: the walk-forward coverage above is the honest check.
The slow spread includes each stock's own earnings and event jumps; a spread computed without them would be the cleaner fix.
